.. py:function:: weighted_mean_delay(monthly_planned_trains: pandas.Series, delay_observations_to_average: pandas.Series) -> float

   Calculate a weighted mean of a series of delay observations weighted by
   the number of trains planned for each period.

   This function can be used to calculate weighted means of the departure or
   arrival delays.

   Both input Series must cover the same periods and have matching indexes.
   Observations with missing values or non-positive (<= 0)
   monthly planned train counts are excluded.

   :param monthly_planned_trains: the number of planned trains
                                  on the selected months.
                                  This Series should normally come from the MONTHLY_PLANNED_TRAINS_KEY.
                                  The Pandas Series must be filtered to only include the periods you want
                                  to include in the calculation.
   :type monthly_planned_trains: pd.Series
   :param delay_observations_to_average: the delay measure or
                                         observations you wish to get the mean.
                                         The Pandas Series must be filtered to only include the
                                         periods you want to average.
   :type delay_observations_to_average: pd.Series

   :returns:

             the delay weighted mean of the valid observations,
                 or NaN if no valid observations are available.
   :rtype: float


.. py:function:: ratio_number_of_trains(monthly_planned_trains: pandas.Series, train_observations: pandas.Series) -> float

   Calculate the ratio of observed trains to planned trains.

   This function can be used to calculate the proportion of delayed or
   cancelled trains among planned trains over the selected periods.

   Both input Series must cover the same periods and have matching indexes.
   Observations with missing values or invalid counts are excluded.

   :param monthly_planned_trains: Number of planned trains for each
                                  selected month, usually from MONTHLY_PLANNED_TRAINS_KEY.
                                  The Series must be filtered to the periods being studied.
   :type monthly_planned_trains: pd.Series
   :param train_observations: Number of delayed or cancelled trains
                              for each selected month. The Series must cover the same periods
                              as monthly_planned_trains.
   :type train_observations: pd.Series

   :returns:

             The ratio of valid train observations to planned trains,
                 or NaN if no valid observations are available.
   :rtype: float

.. py:function:: get_departure_city_mean_delay_df(df: pandas.DataFrame, departure_city: str) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Returns a dataframe containing the mean delay from a departure city, to display
   the horizontal reference on histogram

   :param df: Dataframe from which get the length
   :type df: pd.DataFrame
   :param departure_city: Departure city to compute the mean departure delays from
   :type departure_city: str

   :returns: Dataframe duplicating the computed mean departure delays
             of the length of df
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame


.. py:function:: get_national_global_delay_mean_df(df: pandas.DataFrame) -> pandas.DataFrame

   Returns a dataframe containing the mean delay of
   the whole country, to display the horizontal reference on histogram

   :param df: Dataframe from which get the length
   :type df: pd.DataFrame

   :returns: Dataframe duplicating the computed mean departure delays
             of the length of df
   :rtype: pd.DataFrame
